> **বাংলায় — অ্যাডমিন v5 (প্রোটোটাইপ মেলানো):**
> - 49টা নতুন PR, পাঁচটা ওয়েভে: মেনু আর অর্ডার, কুরিয়ার, রুলস আর অফার, প্রোডাক্ট-ফাইন্যান্স-রিপোর্ট, বাকি সব।

**Done:** 33 / 49 PRs (In progress) · **Wave:** 9 · **PR numbers:** 659–707 · **Register status:** locked; filed 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048) — the owner-approved admin prototype v5 becomes the real admin; Lumen stays the look

*Filed 13 Nov 2026 (CN-048). The owner-approved admin prototype v5 (`docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/`) becomes the real admin: mostly re-arranging screens to the prototype's menu and wiring the backend that is already built. Lumen stays the look. Backend that exists (courier booking and stickers, merge rules, incomplete-order capture, coupons, claims, size charts, exchanges, Customer 360, refunds and wallet, Calls to make, Rider issues, notices) is re-used. Full check: `docs/demo/admin-proto-v5/GAP-MAP.md`. Every new number or switch is a backend setting, off by default; every integration runs on a mock until the owner types the key.*

## PR 659

**Admin shell alignment —**

**বাংলায়:** শেলের মেনু প্রোটোটাইপের মতো সাজানো: Home, Orders, Couriers, Inbox, Rules, Finance — Lumen ডিজাইনই থাকছে, কিছু মোছা হচ্ছে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Admin shell alignment (CN-048; no migration, no new permission; `admin.startPages` accepts the new `rules` section): the left menu as the prototype's `A.NAV` inside the Lumen look — Daily = Home, Orders, Couriers, Products, Customers, Inbox, Rules; Grow = Marketing, Website; Business = Finance, Reports; System = AI Center, Settings, Help. Renames by label only (ids, routes and permissions unchanged): Today to Home, Delivery to Couriers, Support to Inbox, Money to Finance. **Rules is its own section** (`rules`, tab All rules: `/admin/rules`, `/notices`, `/eid`; its guide pages moved to `docs/admin-guide/pages/rules/`). **Messages is folded into Marketing › Message campaigns** (all 8 pages and addresses unchanged; the `messages` section id stays as a `folded` entry with no menu item, so saved settings and its manual chapter live on). A click on the open section's name folds or opens its pages (a double-click folds once); the Orders badge reads "in Processing"; icons: Home, Inbox and a new Rules glyph. Bottom bar stays the superset (the prototype's 5-item bar is a phone subset). 3 new test cases, admin guide updated.
- **What it does (original scope):** **Admin shell alignment** — Left menu as the prototype: groups Daily / Grow / Business / System, renames (Dashboard to Home, Delivery to Couriers, Support to Inbox, Money to Finance), Rules and Couriers as their own sections, Messages entry moves into Marketing, a click on the open section folds it, 3 new icons, the "?" panel slot and the Admin map slot, Orders badge reads Processing. Lumen stays the look; the burnt-orange accent is one existing swatch. Routes stay, nothing deleted. Size M; depends on —; shared files: sections.ts, lumen-nav.ts, admin-shell.*.json (SOLE OWNER first; merge before any other S28 PR touches them).
- **Filed under:** [S28 Wave 1 — shell and orders](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-1--shell-and-orders)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `docs/admin-guide/pages/rules/`
  - Routes: `/admin/rules`, `/notices`, `/eid`
  - Settings and named keys: `admin.startPages`
  - Names in the code: `rules`, `A.NAV`, `messages`, `folded`
  - Tests: 3 new test cases, admin guide updated
- **Links:** [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s28-wave-1--shell-and-orders) · [README feature section](../../README.md#s28--admin-v5-prototype-alignment--in-progress) · [↑ PR list](#prs-in-this-stage)

## PR 660

**Orders section re-map and Processing view —**

**বাংলায়:** অর্ডারের ট্যাব প্রোটোটাইপের মতো: Processing একটা ভিউ, তারিখের ফিল্টার আর বাতিল অর্ডারের সারাংশ।

**Details**

## PR 671

**Courier payouts via the courier own request —**

**বাংলায়:** কুরিয়ারের নিজস্ব পেমেন্ট-রিকোয়েস্টে টাকা চাওয়া, স্ট্যাটাস নিজে নিজে ফিরে আসে, Paid হলে অর্ডার সেটেল।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Courier payouts through the courier's own payment request (CN-048; migration 0220 `CourierPayout`; one new setting `delivery.courier.payouts` v311 (ON by the owner's written OK of 13 Nov, BLOCKED W2-1) with the owner's poll minutes and smallest amount; no new permission; ships ON (owner's OK, 13 Nov), money question in BLOCKED W2-1): Courier 360 › Payouts shows what the courier holds for us (delivered, cash collected, on no statement and in no open request, less its charges), its own balance when it gives one, the open request and the latest ones. "Ask the courier to pay" needs `payments.settle` AND the owner's PIN (`verifyOwnerPin`, never stored or logged) and one request key per press, so a request is asked once; the row is saved first, one request is open at a time, and a courier that did not answer leaves an unconfirmed open request a person closes (never asked twice by guess). Steadfast asks through its own `payment_request`, Pathao only reads, RedX has none (`PAYOUT_NOT_SUPPORTED`); there is no "Ask for payment" of ours. The poll (`courier.payouts` job per slot of the owner's minutes, and "Check now") reads it back REQUESTED → PROCESSING → PAID or REJECTED; PAID settles the covered parcels on an imported statement (`importSettlement`, the same matching as a statement file) in the name of the person who asked, whose `payments.settle` is checked again (else "Mark orders settled" by hand); a paid amount that differs is kept as the courier said and flagged. Never deletes. `PaymentsDeps.couriers` hook (web: `courierApi`; jobs: connections, books and charge-log hooks). Delivery settings gets the "Courier payouts" card. Bengali guide updated. Tests: 7 payments (real PostgreSQL), 1 settings, 1 jobs

## PR 673

**Courier claims ledger v5 —**

**বাংলায়:** কুরিয়ার ক্লেইমের একটাই খাতা: নতুন ধরন, সময়সীমা, উদ্ধার হওয়া টাকা হিসাবে ওঠে।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-13
  - Build status row: Courier claims ledger v5 (CN-048; migration 0221: enum values `SHORT_COD` and `RETURN_SHORT` on `CourierClaimKind` and column `CourierClaim.deadlineAt`, additive; one new setting `delivery.courier.claimTerms` v312: deadline switch OFF, days 30, warn days 5, post-recovered switch ON by the owner's written OK of 13 Nov (BLOCKED W2-2); no new permission; the recovered-money posting ships OFF, question in BLOCKED W2-2): the one claims ledger (`delivery.claims`, the existing table, so Orders, Couriers and Finance read the same rows and the ERP's rider-overcharge claims are in it) gets two new kinds whose amount is typed (the courier handed in less than the parcel collected; a returned parcel came back short), a deadline (set when a claim is raised, the owner's days from that day, none while the switch is off; a claim past it is flagged Late, within the warn days Due soon) and the ledger's words (open and sent as they are, settled with money = Won, settled with nothing or rejected = Lost). Courier 360 gains a Claims section (totals with late count, lost or damaged parcels still to claim, "New claim" form for the typed kinds with one request key per form, every claim with its steps; raising and moving behind the owner's claims switch and `delivery.claims`). Finance › Overview gets the card "Courier claims to receive" (open and sent claims, per courier, late count, linking to that courier's Claims). A claim settled with money hands it once to the books through a new optional hook `claimRecovered` (a record only, never fails the settlement) while "Post money won back" is on; no hook is wired as shipped, so nothing posts. Never deletes. Bengali guides updated (Courier 360, Delivery settings, Finance overview). Tests: 5 payments (real PostgreSQL) + 2 pure, 1 settings, 2 web
- **What it does (original scope):** **Courier claims ledger v5** — New kinds (short COD, return short) and deadline, states mapped to open, sent, won, lost; one ledger shared by Orders, Couriers and Finance together with ERP claims; Finance line "Courier claims to receive"; recovered money posts to the courier account. Size M; depends on 670; shared files: Prisma (enum values, deadline column); payments posting.
